PlanStatus.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for ContingencyPlan.status. DRAFT is set by CreateContingencyPlan, ASSESSING by CreateDeliverabilityAssessment's follow-on lifecycle edit on the owning plan, APPROVED by ApproveContingencyPlan (terminal; re-materialize the plan to start a new round).

displayMetadata.description: 预案实例状态流转的封闭枚举：DRAFT（创建交付预案）→ ASSESSING（登记交付评估时联动推进）→ APPROVED（确认预案版本，终态）。

GapStatus.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for GapItem.status. OPEN is set by CreateGapItem, IN_PROGRESS by GenerateRemediationTask's follow-on lifecycle edit when dispatched against a gap (gapId supplied), CLOSED by CloseGapItem (terminal).

displayMetadata.description: 差异项状态的封闭枚举：OPEN（登记差异）→ IN_PROGRESS（对差异派发整改任务时联动推进）→ CLOSED（关闭差异，终态）。

DataSource.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for *.dataSource (设备/部件/软件/组网/服务 来源).

displayMetadata.description: 配置项数据来源渠道的封闭枚举。

RiskLevel.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for RiskItem.severity / RiskRule.riskLevel (风险等级). 高/中/低 are the EODS lifecycle levels; 风险/重大/待定 are forward-ported verbatim from 04 §19.3 风险规则库 (e.g. DEV-LC-05/NET-PLN-01/ACC-TC-01 标「风险」, SVC-WB-01 标「重大」, NET-VER-01 标「待定」).

displayMetadata.description: 风险等级的封闭枚举：高/中/低 + §19.3 的 风险/重大/待定。

RiskState.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for RiskItem.state (风险处理状态). 已驳回 marks a derived suggestion dismissed by DismissDerivedRisk — kept in the same store so re-derives can be cross-referenced by riskId.

displayMetadata.description: 风险处理状态的封闭枚举：处理中 / 已关闭 / 已驳回（驳回的派生建议留痕）。

NarrativeStatus.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for ChapterNarrative.status — the human-edit-vs-AI lifecycle of a chapter's prose. ai_draft=AI 生成、未经人工改动；human_edited=人工已修改（重生成绝不覆盖 editedText）；merged=已采纳新稿/智能融合稿为正文；regen_pending=人工改后又重生成、新 AI 稿暂存 pendingGenerated 待人合并。

displayMetadata.description: 章节正文的人工/AI 融合状态封闭枚举：ai_draft / human_edited / merged / regen_pending。

RiskPoint.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for RiskRule.riskPoint. Mirrors the EODS 售前风险识别 rule_point vocabulary (生命周期 EOM/TR5/EOS/ESS) plus the full delivery-contingency 风险规则库 forward-ported from 04 §19.3 (设备②/服务③/组网①/验收④ + 任务跟踪 TRK). The 5 lifecycle/acceptance lanes are wired into deriveContingencyRisks subject-gathering today; the remaining points back dormant rule-library rows until the engine gains their gather predicates.

displayMetadata.description: 风险点封闭枚举：生命周期 EOM/TR5/EOS/ESS + 验收到货里程碑缺失风险（已接线），以及 §19.3 设备/服务/组网/验收/任务跟踪 全量风险点（规则库，待接线）。

DecisionConclusion.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for DecisionRecord.conclusion / derivedConclusion. Mirrors the deriveContingencyRisks decision-point output verbatim (可交付 / 存在风险) so a derived conclusion can be recorded without remapping.

displayMetadata.description: 预案决策点结论的封闭枚举，与派生引擎输出对齐：可交付 / 存在风险。

TaskStatus.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for RemediationTask.status. OPEN is set by GenerateRemediationTask, IN_PROGRESS by ModifyInfrastructureConfig, DONE by CompleteRemediationTask; CANCELLED is reserved for a future cancellation action.

displayMetadata.description: 整改任务生命周期状态的封闭枚举。

ActivityScope.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for DeliveryPlanRow.scope / ActivityTemplate.scope. Mirrors 业务语义 10 §3 活动作用域 — the scope tag decides how many instances a template activity expands into and where parallel PoD chains converge (POWER_ON and go-live converge at BATCH).

displayMetadata.description: 活动作用域封闭枚举（10 §3）：PROJECT 项目级一次 / ROOM 机房级一次（机房内 PoD 共享）/ BATCH 批次级一次（批内 PoD 统一汇合）/ POD 每 PoD 各一份（可并行）。

ActivityKind.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for DeliveryPlanRow.activityType. Mirrors 业务语义 10 §2 活动五分类 (普通执行/里程碑/到货/机房准备/返工); REWORK rows are inserted by ReworkEvent application and never mutate the original activity.

displayMetadata.description: 活动五分类封闭枚举（10 §2）：NORMAL 普通执行 / MILESTONE 里程碑 / ARRIVAL 到货 / ROOM_PREP 机房准备 / REWORK 返工。

AnchorPriority.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: anchor priority 1-5 for Milestone.anchorPriority (12 §3). Smaller is higher priority: 1 delivery milestones (go-live/power-on/handover), 2 arrival, 3 room readiness, 4 other activity anchors, 5 customer soft preferences.

displayMetadata.description: 锚点优先级 1–5（12 §3），数值越小越优先；多锚点冲突时优先满足高优先级。

AnchorKind.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for Milestone.anchorKind (12 §3). HARD anchors are delivery milestones and locked upstream inputs; SOFT anchors are customer preferences (convertible to HARD when the customer commits to a date). Unlocked arrival/room-ready inputs stay HARD but remain pull-able by strategy C until locked.

displayMetadata.description: 锚点硬/软封闭枚举（12 §3）：HARD 硬约束 / SOFT 软约束（客户偏好类，明确日期后可转硬）。

AdjustmentDirection.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for AdjustmentRequest.direction (30 §8 用户诉求方向).

displayMetadata.description: 调整诉求方向封闭枚举：ADVANCE 提前 K 天 / DELAY 延后 K 天 / DEADLINE 某日期前完成。

AdjustmentTargetType.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for AdjustmentRequest.targetType — which object kind a user adjustment request points at.

displayMetadata.description: 调整对象类型封闭枚举：PLAN_ROW 活动行 / MILESTONE 里程碑 / BATCH 批次 / ROOM 机房 / ARRIVAL_ITEM 到货明细。

AdjustmentStatus.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration shared by AdjustmentRequest.status and ReworkEvent.status — the 攒变更 → 确认 → 推演 → 写回 lifecycle of 13 §1. PENDING accumulates and dedupes by entity; only CONFIRMED items enter sandbox simulation.

displayMetadata.description: 攒变更生命周期封闭枚举（13 §1）：PENDING 已录入待确认 / CONFIRMED 已确认待推演 / SIMULATED 已推演 / APPLIED 已写回 / DISCARDED 已丢弃。

ScheduleVersionStatus.description: Palantir-style local Value Type: closed enumeration for SchedulePlanVersion.status. ACTIVE is the live plan version; accepting a new scenario flips the previous ACTIVE to SUPERSEDED; rolling back marks the abandoned version ROLLED_BACK.

displayMetadata.description: 排期计划版本状态封闭枚举：ACTIVE 当前生效 / SUPERSEDED 已被覆盖 / ROLLED_BACK 已回滚弃用。
